items.title: Percy Stovall Interview, 1977-12-27
items.q: So what we did, we laid two pieces out... we made the band a little bigger. So we got to traveling... him and Slim would work together... we cut the first session on Slim there.

ctx.x: Yeah, so you started making your contacts and then once you had your contacts set in a few tabs, you just keep sending bands to them that you were working with.
Yeah. Now I can start to tell you about Slim, because this is time for him to come in right now. So later I met, later I met Gitar Slim.
Wait, who was your first big, your hottest act, your first hot act that you were in? Well, well, somebody trying to get some? Yeah. S-U-P? I'm going. I got it.
